s: Sheyyesadder shulchano bemotzae shabbat ubo d' seipim: leolam yesadder adam shulchano bemotzae shabbat bekol mine siddur hannehugim etzlo baarikat hashshulchan lisudda gemura, ap al pi sheakshav lo yokal ella kezayit, hen mechamat sheen lo yoter, hen mechamat sheeno taeb leyoter, mikkol maqom yesh lo laasot hakana besiddur hashshulchan, kegon perisat mappa vekayyotze bazeh kemo lisudda gemura, kede lelavvot et hashshabbat bitziato derek kabod kemo biknisato, kemo shennitbaer besimman r[s]"b:

Velaken yesh nohagim leharbot nerot bemotzae shabbat yoter mishshear lelot hachol. Venohagim gam ken lomar piyyutim uzemirot achar habdala, lelavvot et hashshabbat achar sheyyatza kederek shemmelavvin et hammelek achar sheyyatza min hair:

Vetob lebashshel basar o dabar acher bemotzae shabbat likbod seudda zo. Ubizmannenu shemmeacharin kol kak seudda g' sheen yekolim leekol bemotzae shabbat — yekolim leqayyem seudda zo beperot. (Veen tzarik lehaqdim seudda g' bishbil sheyyoklu seudda zo karauy, shesseudda zo enah choba kol kak, ella mitzva min hammubchar bilbad):
Yesh mehamdaqdeqim shehaya lo tallit (meyuchad) shel mitzva meyuchedet leshabbat, ubekol motzae shabbat haya qopelah, kede lehitasseq bemitzva miyyad:
